diminishing.note: 1st-2nd flaw full, 3rd-4th half (round down), 5th+ 0 CP (story flaws).

same_area: Only the highest-CP flaw in one area pays; the others are story flaws.

heavy_load.note: Intensity of a fixed-CP flaw = its CP.

buy_off: Story (surgery, cure, quest, atonement) AND paying back its CP with XP/mastery uses. Flaws gained in play pay no CP.
